notes.title: March Madness Meets Save the Villainess!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ffc5042004727386ee1d81aec3092400080149d3.jpg[/img]

Dear Villains and Villainesses, 

This is Tanya and Emily, the developers of Save the Villainess. We are excited to bring you the first official update of the spring. We had a lot of fun preparing writing and programming updates, as well as letting you know about a Dream Lover tournament where you get to cast the final deciding vote on who is the dreamiest love interest in our game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/271e2df0163ddc6b47644fef43f5e3bc0b18303a.png[/img]

One of our major goals in our game is to allow players to spend quality time with characters even as we introduce more complexities and complications into our murder-mystery plot. Understanding the characters brings you ever closer to unraveling the mysteries of the game - who wants to kill the villainess and how can she be saved?

This month, we balanced character interactions with the mystery elements of our story as we worked on scenes from our Common Route (CR). Specifically, we wrote and edited scenes CR 14 and 15. These scenes give Jane the chance to receive vital information that will assist with a major point-and-click mystery sequence in scene CR 16.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/cc7a57e03c78c4c8a437e17d1b893172d31bb043.png[/img]

[i]Note: If you consider the dangers of wainscoting, cushions, and asking for food other than apples, perhaps postcards too conceal sinister secrets. Why do you think that Servant hates them so?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/5e288e126631ba639758e100cab2b24a2055dc4f.png[/img]

In Save the Villainess, you are in charge of keeping your villainess safe from harm. Thus, you must investigate every possible object that may cause her harm… including the rooms of the murderous and possibly sentient apple-loving House where she is stranded.

Our point-and-click and mystery deductions are inspired by games like Unavowed, Grim Fandango, Sweet Fuse, Contradiction: Spot the Liar, and Even if Tempest. Just like these mystery games, we put our protagonist’s fate in your hands. Her survival depends on your cunning and detective skills.

We are currently developing the major point-and-click deduction puzzle of scene CR 16. Our goal is to create a puzzle that is more complex than the “beginner” puzzle in the  the demo. Fans of mystery games will find this a fun challenge! However, if you would ever like more help with the mysteries, you can always turn on Story Mode or use the free walkthrough we will release when the game is out. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/632b9beb07c19e9fdf86faa026336bf9852687b5.gif[/img]

[i]Note: Did you think the cushions were the only furniture you had to fight to secure your villainess' freedom?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2a3823c19145b3b4e0ada240b7fda89a5d9657ad.png[/img]

Since March is a great month for tournaments, we’re excited to announce that we’re in the final bracket of our own tournament… and that you have the chance to cast a deciding vote!

A few weeks ago, we began the Save the Villainess Dream Lover tournament, which featured fierce fights between the love interests of our game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/36483be29c44d3ec00f8c422968b58abd7e5c949.png[/img]

Our characters have gone through seven rounds of fierce fighting, with each round accompanied by [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zgoylUglQ78eTcdLRXlGBjm1sUvoWXp_?usp=sharing]personal cards from the characters[/url] in both victory and defeat, as well as a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nY3U4swvlhQ&list=PL-woj8NObc6eLM-V6yQzYWJuaK_U3KLBC]special Youtube video playlist[/url]. 

Finally, we are at the finals, with Izel Kuzey (our Duke of the North) and Servant (the extremely normal servant) making their final appeals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/689c67412eca2849232833dbf4ddcdcf65a436ad.png[/img]

Will Izel’s passionate words about love sway you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/721079e59d58430739101c4ad5012ece87ef2952.png[/img]

Or has Servant’s success at… parties stolen your heart?

Cast your vote now and remember… the ultimate winner will be declared the fan favorite dream lover and will be featured in a special ‘video date’! 

Finally, please remember you can always catch us at the various sites below:

[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5tQZUFwAH]Our discord server[/url] - come chat with us and hear what other players have discovered about our game!
[*] [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]Our mailing list[/url] - we send free cards featuring new banter from our main characters every month. This March, Jane, Edmund, Izel, Ben, and Servant talk to you about their favorite reading materials in honor of National Reading Month! 
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@BestLaidPlansProductions]Youtube[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/bestlaidplans.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], and [url=https://www.tumblr.com/bestlaidplansproductions]Tumblr[/url] - our main social media accounts
[/list]

Thanks again for joining us for another lovely month and update, friends. We’ll see you in April with the winner of the Dream Lover tournament and with more fun updates on our game! 

With Much Love,
Tanya & Emily
Best Laid Plans Productions, Inc.

notes.title: Meet Raymond Alpin, the Man With a Plan!
notes.content:
Dear Villains and Villainesses, 

This is Tanya and Emily, your friendly developers of Save the Villainess. We hope you are having a fabulous end to your month… and we are excited to bring you a special Valentine's Day-themed update. We wanted to celebrate the season by programming one of our most gorgeous characters and talking about a plethora of romantic writing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/e7a8cdf518f4c2aef0558db7b65d3408e434a204.png[/img]

This month, we finished the base programming for the amazing Raymond Alpin! Raymond is the royal cousin of Crown Prince Edmund Alpin, which means that Raymond is directly in line for the throne should Edmund pass away without any children. If Raymond has his way, that possibility might not end up being so distant either…

[previewyoutube=B-fZed3W76g;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, Raymond is a very… confident man. He’s convinced he’s the best potential ruler the kingdom of Carcosa has… as well as a good candidate for being the most arrogant man in Carcosa. 

Then again, is it arrogance if you really are that good?

So far, we have completed the base body programming on Raymond’s character model, which means we converted the Adobe Photoshop (aka PSD) file containing his art into hundreds of layers, the base of which we animated within the Ren’py engine using a combination of traditional animation, math, and coding. 

In future months, we will animate Raymond’s individual facial expressions so he can show off his joy, rage, sorrow, and even his sweetly blushing face. As we’ve mentioned previously, the complete sprite process can take upwards of one hundred hours. We look forward to showing you more of Raymond when this process finishes! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/271e2df0163ddc6b47644fef43f5e3bc0b18303a.png[/img]

Save the Villainess is a choice-heavy game that puts our villainess’ romantic fate in your hands. You get to determine not only which lover she chooses… but if she should be with a lover at all! Thus, the game features several romantic routes you can go down… including 5 romantic happy endings with each of the love interests and 3 different single endings, as well as several different secret endings you must unlock for yourself. 

In honor of Valentine’s Day, we wanted to further enrich the romance in the game. Therefore, we revised all of the post-demo romantic choices in our common route. Now, when you choose affection raising and lowering choices, you will get longer dialogue skits and a deeper understanding of our love interests. The game will also remember these choices and use them to shape some later conversations in the game.

If you choose the affection raising choices, you’ll generally get sweet, affectionate moments that display more of the chemistry between Jane and her love interest that would make them work as a couple. If you are brave enough to choose the affection lowering choices, you may discover secrets about the characters’ lives that you might not otherwise discover until much later in the game.

Below is an example of an affection lowering choice that allows you to learn more about Izel, Duke of the North. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/5c916891a422d3e2f578947dc3dd2ea7df157542.png[/img]

What choices will you make throughout the game? Play it for yourself and watch the mysteries unravel through your decisions…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2a3823c19145b3b4e0ada240b7fda89a5d9657ad.png[/img]

This month, we had the great luck to be featured in two different Steam festivals that celebrate the power of storytelling and the creativity of women in gaming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/e10cbf078eef50d65df0ccf4e6cff3bd77770ae4.png[/img]

First, we were featured in the Storyteller Festival run by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios]Two and a Half Studios[/url], the creators of Date with Death and the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3477910/The_Willowmist_Emporium_of_Antiques__Curiosities/]Willowmist Emporium of Antiques and Curiosities[/url]. This festival celebrates the magic of amazing storytelling in a wide variety of game genres. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/TwoHalfStudios/sale/thestorytellersfestival2025]Check out the festival page here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/b901fce2c842008d110744d4ff0c1028a0f3a647.png[/img]

Second, we are being featured in the Women’s Day Sale, which supports women-led games in a variety of ways. During this festival, we are streaming part of our demo with the amazing [url=https://otomeaddicted.carrd.co/]OtomeAddicted[/url] on our Steam page. Please see it on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578180/Save_the_Villainess_An_Otome_Isekai_Roleplaying_Game/]our Steam page[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2b64200bb4560c8507dc1e37f375c2213d50816f.png[/img]

We wanted to end by raving about Silent Kingdom, an amazing otome RPG!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/7f6d18d1dadd38a2057ba1d6c48755b89bf295d2.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828650/The_Silent_Kingdom/]Silent Kingdom[/url] is a dark, gorgeous, and beautiful game that has you play the role of Princess Erinys, whose kingdom has fallen under the yoke of a sorrowful curse. In order to save everything you have ever known and loved, you’ll have to stand against the entire world - and even defy the Goddess herself. 

Along the way, you will make many impactful decisions that will lead you to be loved or loathed, to slay or be slain, and to either save or damn your kingdom forever. The game also features a thrilling RPG battle system where you must work with your partners to overcome terrifying monsters. 

If you love dark fantasy, beautiful hand-drawn art, and thrilling battles, you will truly enjoy Silent Kingdom, which is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828650/The_Silent_Kingdom/]available in early access on Steam now[/url]. 

Finally, please remember you can always catch us at the various sites below:

[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5tQZUFwAH]Our discord server[/url] - come chat with us and hear what other players have discovered about our game!
[*] [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]Our mailing list[/url] - we send free cards featuring new banter from our main characters every month. This month, Jane, Edmund, Izel, Ben, and Servant tell you about what romantic gifts they would give you!
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@BestLaidPlansProductions]Youtube[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/bestlaidplans.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], and [url=https://www.tumblr.com/bestlaidplansproductions]Tumblr[/url] - our main social media accounts
[/list]

With Much Love,
Tanya & Emily
Best Laid Plans Productions, Inc.

notes.title: Animating Young Jane, Celebrating Servant's Birthday, & The Elimination Game!
notes.content:
Dear Villains and Villainesses, 

This is Tanya and Emily, the two developers behind Save the Villainess. We’re here to wish you a Happy Lunar New Year – one that we hope is full of hope, joy, and growth for you! We’ll also share our monthly update about our game, including fantastic news on a major development for young Jane, a celebration of Servant's birthday, and a conclusion to last month's elimination game. We are starting 2025 off with a bang!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/e7a8cdf518f4c2aef0558db7b65d3408e434a204.png[/img]

Our major news is that we’ve completed our initial programming of the teenage version of Jane Neville, the villainess of our game’s title! As you can see from the video below, young Jane’s face, hair, and body are now fully animated and ready to come to life in the flashbacks of our story.

[previewyoutube=18yvfINC_p4;full][/previewyoutube]

Every character model within our game is a custom work of art which can take 100+ hours to complete. Animating a single character model is a painstaking process that involves everything from the initial character creation to the creation of character parts to the animation of the character in the game engine. 

Even so, we love the process of animating each of our characters because we can give each of them their unique sense of life and personality. Thank you again for your support as we go on this journey with every single character in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/271e2df0163ddc6b47644fef43f5e3bc0b18303a.png[/img]

We also made great progress on our writing as well this month! We were fired up by the long but important process of animating teen Jane and thus, sat down with our master outline and wrote out two very important flashback scenes with her.

These scenes include some special guest stars that you’ll only learn about when you play the game itself. As you'll see when you witness the scenes, nothing about Jane is as it seems at first sight… and the interactions young Jane has with others may tell a different story than the one you think is unfolding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/4fc6fd8cf12ede93426c4ce8296ff8af5c363b40.png[/img]

January also marks the amazing and enigmatic Servant's birthday – which technically took place on January 1st!

In honor of this special event, Jane, the villainess lead of Save the Villainess, is interviewing Servant. Hear them spill a few secrets about themselves and the world below.

[previewyoutube=rGsLK1laki8;full][/previewyoutube]

Do you feel the need to pry a few more secrets out of Servant? You’ll have to play the full game to learn more of what they are hiding….

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/2a3823c19145b3b4e0ada240b7fda89a5d9657ad.png[/img]

Finally, we wanted to bring you a conclusion to the elimination game that started last month! Cloudy_floofs started the game, which gradually whittled down the 18 (yes, 18!) characters and/or creatures and/or unholy abominations that showed up in our demo to one remaining contestant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ce74668082c90ccb3e578a24ab34f714d01ac966.png[/img]

Behold Cloudy_Floof's masterpiece. 18 contestants come in from the demo... only who will win?

Every time one of the most important characters were eliminated, they even wrote a little card to express their feelings. You can preview the cards below or take a closer look at them in this [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1JrwwJdGDhSmVFaYjs6U9dH0oHTdnWO2k]google drive folder[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ac8b0109c43f1cfc61aa029e64a2fd0726a7ca91.png[/img]

MOST of the contestants lost gracefully! However, Horse may still hold a grudge...

A few people also expressed their strange distaste for Ben Buren, our game’s childhood friend. Of course, Ben had to respond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/ff01778eb239f4d0801f9402febb8a02682005d4.png[/img]

Why is Ben so hated? That’s a secret still to be told… though maybe you’ll learn it during the course of our story.

Finally, after fans voted on all our social media, one person was left standing. So she's ready to thank you for keeping her safe!

[previewyoutube=bqbZpRn043c;full][/previewyoutube]

Friends, we thank you for spending another month with us and hope you have a wonderful year ahead of you. Please remember you can always catch us at the various sites below:
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5tQZUFwAH]Our discord server[/url] - come chat with us and hear what other players have discovered about our game!
[*] [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]Our mailing list[/url] - we send free cards featuring new banter from our main characters every month. This month, Jane, Edmund, Izel, Ben, and Servant tell you want they think about Servant!
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@BestLaidPlansProductions]Youtube[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/bestlaidplans.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], and [url=https://www.tumblr.com/bestlaidplansproductions]Tumblr[/url] - our main social media accounts
[/list]
We hope you have a wonderful year ahead of you as well. Thanks for your support and take care until we talk again!

With Much Love,
Tanya & Emily
Best Laid Plans Productions, Inc.

notes.title: Free New Prequel Novel for Save the Villainess & Demo/Kickstarter Updates!
notes.content:
Dear Villainesses and Villains:

This is Tanya and Emily, the co-developers of Save the Villainess. We hope you’re enjoying the beautiful buds of May! We’re excited because we’re close to finishing up our final demo and have some Kickstarter secrets to share!

We also have a wonderful surprise – the first chapter of a brand new novel called “The Villainess Wants Her Prince to Live” – a prequel to Save the Villainess. It is live on Wattpad and Royal Roads now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/cf0c2214b6a886ec3d173e52a93494bede5b2186.png[/img]

While you wait for our final demo and Kickstarter campaign, we wrote new romantic murder-mystery novel that is a prequel to Save the Villainess. (The novel takes place several decades before the events of the game).

Our new novel is called “The Villainess Wants Her Prince to Live!”

[i][b]Summary[/b][/i]: “Regina Sheridan can see the future. Unfortunately, the future says that she will be executed as a villainess unless she can keep her new fiancé, Prince Artem Alpin, alive. The future also tells her someone is hunting Artem… and that he has the survival instincts of a goldfish. Please universe, The Villainess Wants Her Prince to Live!”

[previewyoutube=6Fqo8aZEhgQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://tapas.io/series/The-Villainess-Wants-Her-Prince-to-Live/info]Tapas.io Link.
[/url]

[url=https://www.wattpad.com/story/370070686-the-villainess-wants-her-prince-to-live]Royal Roads Link.[/url]

We appreciate any likes or comments you have for our story, since it helps us find new readers. We will also update our completely outlined story on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays. Subscribe to our story on either site for more – and happy reading!

([b]Note[/b]: You do [i][b]not[/b][/i] need to read “The Villainess Wants Her Prince to Live” to play Save the Villainess. However, the novel does offer interesting lore on the characters’ families for readers – as well as a fun murder-mystery similar to what you will find in the actual game!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/8d5449702e7532d358775c0cf94756249401d1c1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/05bfcc39a45822e819198463b910cbe87fb224db.gif[/img]

We have been working hard on Save the Villainess’ upcoming Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign, which will allow our game to include dazzling new art and scenes. Here a few of the rewards you can get during our campaign:

[list]
[*] A digital game code for Save the Villainess on Steam or Itch-dot-io for just $20 - limited time only!
[*] Personalized videos from your favorite characters
[*] Several digital books, including an art book and character diaries
[*] A chance to name some of the animals and objects of our game (including Feet Fish!)
[*] A chance to commission a plot-important portrait of yourself that appears in the game
[/list]

Interested in hearing more about our Kickstarter campaign as soon as it drops? 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/565568843/save-the-villainess-an-otome-isekai-roleplaying-game]You can sign up to our Kickstarter pre-campaign page here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/e93513db8fde06797a931232e2ceaa474ea7193b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/776c7c6aa131c11479cfff479af7a533f0d96f9e.gif[/img]

We are working hard on our final demo. Among other things, Emily has revised thousands of lines of programming code to make our detailed animations load faster. Emily also created a very cool (and long) credits scene, added in a new secret, and added some changes based on feedback of beta testers.

(Let’s just say that when you play the final demo and put in the most common favorite foods of our beta testers, you will get some interesting surprises…)

We are now waiting for some final updated art/video assets to incorporate and are implementing final changes before testing our demo. We look forward to finishing our work and sharing the polished demo with the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830440/03718239c50049e81e8bd70ef0fb6d412b4b5a18.png[/img]

This month on our mailing list, we're also offering brand new character cards giving information about the what our main cast members think of our new novel. Want those cards? [url=https://subscribepage.io/029GuV]Sign up for our mailing list today![/url]
